name: Jellyfin Content Filter
overview: Scan and filter objectionable content using a local LLM
description: A Jellyfin plugin that scans media files for objectionable content categories using a local Ollama LLM instance and stores results as JCF sidecar files. During playback, flagged segments can be automatically skipped or muted based on per-category preferences.

versions.changelog: Fix plugin configuration page DOM layout, script lifecycle execution in Jellyfin SPA, and dynamic version badge synchronization.
FileTransformation typed callback support for dynamic index.html script injection, instant library cache, and multi-session player seeking.
Seamless client script injection into Jellyfin Web index.html via FileTransformation, instant in-memory library loading, and robust multi-session player seeking.
High-performance in-memory library loading cache and sidecar index, frame-accurate client-side skipping with on-screen HUD badge, and hardened multi-session server playback monitor.

Unify Content Filter Studio, Filter Rules, and AI Scanner Settings into a seamless top-tabbed interface on the primary plugin configuration page, ensuring immediate access upon clicking plugin settings in Jellyfin.

Complete redesign into Content Filter Studio. Fixed missing styles caused by Jellyfin single-page client lifecycle. Added per-season collapsible episode browsing for shows with many seasons, individual segment deletion and addition endpoints, improved search, and sleek dark aesthetic.

Redesign UI into a modern Content Filter Studio, add full season and episode hierarchy enumeration for all TV shows, add library browsing for shows and movies, category metrics chips, bulk actions, and smart batch season matching.
Improve JCF file import flow: zero-config sidecar auto-discovery, interactive media library search, drag-and-drop dropzone with preview, and multi-file batch import.
Word-boundary profanity matching, background task cancellation fixes, seek target reset, and test suite.
